[[File:Disruptorrifle.png|thumb|250px|A disruptor rifle]]
{{Quote|This ain't no simple blaster rifle here. You got yourself a full-blown, first class disruptor.|A shady dealer|<ref name="The Price of Victory">{{SWGTCG|set=The Price of Victory|cardname=Disruptor Rifle}}</ref>}}
A '''disruptor rifle''' was a vicious and devastating weapon that disintegrated its target. It tore apart its victim at the molecular level, destroying their body tissues and bypassing most sorts of [[Personal energy shield/Legends|personal energy shields]].

A disruptor weapon shot a constant beam of energy that would travel in a straight direction until it hit solid matter, so this made disruptors very popular as snipers, and most types of disruptor were manufactured with built in scopes. The use of disruptor weapons was illegal in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], and therefore was usually associated with shadier organizations, such as crime syndicates and [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]], and the weapons became prime smuggling objects, as they were highly valued in taboo areas. The weapon was also utilized by [[Tyber Zann]] and his [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Consortium]] to defeat the enemies he faced in his campaign for corruption. One of the most popular disruptor rifle models was the [[Tenloss Syndicate/Legends|Tenloss]] [[DXR-6 disruptor rifle|DXR-6]]. A smaller version of the disruptor rifle was the [[Disruptor pistol/Legends|disruptor pistol]], which was lighter and smaller but still almost as deadly as its larger cousin.

[[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]] used a different type of the disruptor rifle. This was not a weapon used for sniping. It shot a small green plasma ball that exploded and did a large amount of damage. It was much like a miniature [[Seismic charge/Legends|seismic charge]], as it distorted sound and its explosion had a distinct horizontal shock wave.
